s.note: the bag of seeds the Vuvalini carry
s.how: Mix 50g each sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, 30g linseeds, 30g chia seeds and 100g oats with 250ml water and salt. Rest 30 minutes, spread thin on a lined tray and bake at 160C for an hour. Break into shards.

s.note: Max catches a lizard to eat in the opening, these are chicken
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into strips and rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin and chilli flakes. Thread onto skewers and grill hot until blackened at the edges. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a crushed garlic clove to dip.

m.note: the Citadel up on the rocks
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 3 tbsp harissa, garlic and cumin. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Blitz a tin of chickpeas into hummus. Char 2 red capsicums. Serve with 6 blistered flatbreads.

w.note: the long ride through the desert
w.how: Blitz 250g medjool dates, 100g oats, 100g almonds and 2 tbsp honey until sticky. Press into a lined tray. Pour over 150g melted dark chocolate, sprinkle with sea salt and chill to set. Cut into bars.

d.note: Immortan Joe's warning about getting addicted to water
d.how: In two big jugs muddle a sliced Lebanese cucumber, 3 sliced limes, a handful of mint and 3 tbsp caster sugar until fragrant. Fill with ice and top with 2L cold sparkling water. Stir and pour freely for everyone.
